item.title: Shounen to Tomodachi no Mama: Naisho no "Nakayoshi Gokko"
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nemumi Everyday
  • 発売日: 2020-06-20
  • スコア: 5.76/10 (5 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 少年と友達のママ ナイショの「仲良しごっこ」
  • 英語名: Shounen to Tomodachi no Mama: Naisho no “Nakayoshi Gokko”

别名

  • Secret Playtime with My Friends Mother

あらすじ

One day, Haru was going to a sleepover at his friend Kouki’s house.

When he got there, he met Kouki’s beautiful mom.

The boys were going to sleep soon, so they went to take a bath.

Wait… Kouki’s mom is gonna go in with them?!
